title: 新加坡新生水系統
summary: 以多重處理屏障、物料平衡與水質證據，理解再生水如何連接城市與工業用水。
summaryEn: Understand how reclaimed water links cities and industry through multiple treatment barriers, mass balance and water-quality evidence.
scope: 以公開資料建立的原創教學分解；所有步驟為紙上、數位模型與證據判讀練習。自繪的示意與自設資料必須標示假設；本站未提供現地工程資料，亦不是核准施工、設備操作或水質放行程序。
scopeEn: Original educational decomposition of public information. Every step is a paper, digital-model or evidence-interpretation exercise. Label assumptions in self-drawn diagrams and invented data; this site does not supply field engineering records or approved construction, operating or water-release procedures.
